title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion on Checkout Service

impact.user_impact_summary: Customers experienced intermittent HTTP 500 errors and timeout failures during checkout cart finalization.

five_whys.question: Why did checkout requests fail with HTTP 500 errors?
five_whys.answer: The checkout-api service exhausted all available database connections in its connection pool.

five_whys.question: Why was the database connection pool exhausted?
five_whys.answer: A configuration change in release v2.4.1 decreased max connections from 50 to 10 per replica while setting idle timeout to 0ms.

five_whys.question: Why was the connection pool setting changed in v2.4.1?
five_whys.answer: A performance refactoring PR intended to optimize memory footprint mistakenly applied test-suite pool settings to production.

five_whys.question: Why did staging tests not detect the connection starvation under load?
five_whys.answer: Synthetic integration tests in staging ran with low concurrency (2 RPS), which did not saturate the 10-connection limit.

five_whys.question: Why was there no automated load testing gate in the CI/CD pipeline prior to deployment?
five_whys.answer: Automated performance load testing (k6) was only scheduled weekly rather than as a mandatory blocking gate on pull requests.

what_went_well: Prometheus alert 'CheckoutServiceHigh5xxErrorRate' fired within 6 minutes of release v2.4.1.
Incident Commander declared P1 swiftly and assembled cross-functional team in #incident-inc-402.
Automated canary rollback procedure executed cleanly within 5 minutes of decision.
what_went_poorly: No automated canary release gate: v2.4.1 was rolled out to 100% of traffic immediately.
Staging environment load testing did not mimic production peak concurrency.
Database connection metrics dashboard was not pinned in the main SRE triage view.
where_we_got_lucky: Outage occurred during off-peak European hours, limiting overall customer transactions affected.
Database server itself did not crash or corrupt transactions; Postgres remained healthy.

action_items.description: Add automated pre-deployment load test step (k6) to CI/CD pipeline validating 100 RPS pool limits.
Implement progressive Canary Deployments (10% -> 25% -> 100%) via ArgoCD with automated rollback on error rate > 1%.
Create Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate Prometheus alert on DB pool saturation (>80% utilization for 2m).
Update Runbook for Database Pool Exhaustion with step-by-step pool resizing without full service restart.
